what: The final status of every card in the research audit of 2026-10-14/15 (384 cards plus 14 reconstruction items) and of the 43 follow-up doubts. AUDIT_V2.md is written from this file. Words: see 'words'. Refs name entries in docs/research/GROK_ERA_ERRATA.md (E-...) or in docs/knowledge/due_list.json (everything else).

words.DONE: The action was carried out. The evidence names the commit or file, and a test pins it where one could.
words.RECORDED: A standing decision; nothing is owed. The verdict is the record, or the rule is already written in RESEARCH_RULES.md or another document.
words.ERRATA: What needs correcting lives in frozen Grok-era files that are never edited. The correction is an entry in docs/research/GROK_ERA_ERRATA.md.
words.SCHEDULED: Owned by a dated or recurring step on the due list (docs/knowledge/due_list.json): nightly, weekly, monthly, quarterly, a checkpoint or a ledger question.
words.PARKED_WINDOW: New research, a re-test or a build. Rule B and the sealed holdout say it waits until after the 60-market-day evidence window, so it is on the post-window list.
words.OWNER_DECISION: Only Madhav can decide (spending, retiring or resuming a book, changing a rule). It is on the due list with its options and a recommendation.
words.SUPERSEDED: Later work replaced the item. The refs name what replaced it.
words.ALREADY_FIXED: Used for the follow-up doubts only: the problem was real but an earlier change had already fixed it.
